# `toolu babysit`

Babysit a PR until CI, review threads and the review-bot verdict are clear.

Owner: `plugins/pr-babysit`.
Alias: `pr-babysit`.

## `toolu babysit`

```text
Babysit a PR until CI, review threads and the review-bot verdict are clear

Usage: toolu babysit [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  tick           Run one check of the pull request
  wait           Run scheduled checks until one needs the agent or the time is up
  collect        Read one snapshot of the PR
  reduce-state   Reduce a snapshot against a state and print both
  parse-verdict  Parse a review-bot comment on stdin
  record         Record the agent's bookkeeping in the state
  reply          Post the one reply to a thread, comment or review
  resolve        Resolve a review thread
  route-fix      Group fix items by host, model and effort
  dispatch-fix   Run a route plan's fixer groups
  fixer-report   A fixer's report on its group
  stop           Clean up the fixer round, then record cancelled
  help           Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json              Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
  -q, --quiet             Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>       The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse]
      --config-dir <DIR>  Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help              Print help
```

## `toolu babysit tick`

```text
Run one check of the pull request

Usage: toolu babysit tick [OPTIONS] --repo <VALUE> --pr <VALUE> --state-file <VALUE>

Options:
      --json                  Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
      --repo <VALUE>          The repository, owner/repo
      --pr <VALUE>            The pull request number
  -q, --quiet                 Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>           The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse]
      --page-size <VALUE>     Items per GitHub page [default: 100]
      --config-dir <DIR>      Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
      --timeout <VALUE>       Seconds each GitHub call may take
      --state-file <VALUE>    The slot's state file
      --snapshot-out <VALUE>  Where the snapshot goes; <stem>.snapshot.json by default
      --snapshot-in <VALUE>   Reduce this recorded snapshot instead of reading GitHub
      --now <VALUE>           The check's time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ
  -h, --help                  Print help
```
